title: Spain-Belgium live: Roja's perfect defence meets Red Devils' resilience in World Cup quarter-finals
summary: Spain and Belgium clash in a tasteful quarter-final encounter on Friday, with both European nations seeking to reach the World Cup semi-finals in a 1986 rematch. The Roja and the Red Devils bring contrasting styles and experiences to this knockout tie, but only one of them will advance to face France in the final four. Follow our liveblog to see our minute-…
